Name: Shephatiah, Son of Maachah
Summary: Son of Maachah, ruler of the Simeonites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:16: Son of Maachah, ruler of the Simeonites.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shephatiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
